prompt: Frankie calls the big parade downtown
title: Big Parade Stomp
irony: Frankie calls the parade like a grand final to crown a winner, but a parade has no finish line, so the only win is slowing down and marching together.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Drums thump on the downtown street as banners flap and kids line up behind Frankie's porch microphone.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Teddy corrects the drum count from his fact book, clutching his dinosaur flag beside kind Benny.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Frankie booms And they're off over the speaker as Knox dares Teddy to sprint ahead and win.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The whole street chants the parade hook as drums pound and feet stomp downtown.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Teddy sprints ahead, takes the race call literally, tangles his flag and loses sight of Benny.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Teddy stomps fast around the empty corner alone while the parade band turns the other way.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The crowd keeps chanting downtown as Benny leaves the line to fetch Teddy.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Frankie watches the split parade from her porch and admits her race calls broke the stroll.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Frankie drops the microphone, steps into the street and invites Teddy to stomp slow beside Benny.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: The reunited street stomps slow together as Frankie turns the last line and crowns the slow march.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: The hook rings out downtown as everyone stomps slow past the porch, marching as one long line.
